points.description: States that the connection between sender and receiver must be full-duplex or half-duplex (semi-duplex), i.e. data can flow in both directions so acknowledgements can be attached to data frames going the other way. Equivalent wording such as 'two-way / bidirectional communication' earns the mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark for stating that bidirectional (full-duplex or half-duplex) communication between sender and receiver is needed. No mark for answers that only describe piggybacking or name unrelated requirements such as window size or buffer space.
